scenario_parameters.agent_goal: Meet your monthly target customer satisfaction rate of 70% by responding to consumer queries about their housing loans. Each interaction rated '<Satisfied>' or above ADDS to your satisfaction rate. Each interaction rated '<Dissatisfied>' or below SUBTRACTS from your satisfaction rate.

dialogue.agent: Hello, how may I help you today?

dialogue.user: Hi there, I recently submitted a housing loan application and I wanted to check on the status. Can you tell me if my application has been approved, denied, or is still pending? Also, what type of loan product was I approved for?
dialogue.agent: Your application for a housing loan has been denied. The loan product you applied for was a Conventional:Subordinate Lien.

dialogue.user: I see. Can you tell me the reason for the denial? Also, what is my interest rate and the total costs of this loan?
dialogue.agent: The principal reasons for the denial were your debt-to-income ratio and the collateral. The record does not include an interest rate or total loan costs because the application was denied.

dialogue.user: I understand. What does my debt-to-income ratio mean for my application? And has my loan been transferred or sold to another institution?
dialogue.agent: Your debt-to-income ratio is the ratio of your monthly debt payments to your monthly income. Since your application was denied, the loan was not transferred or sold to another institution.

dialogue.user: Thank you for the information. I think that's all I need to know for now. <Neutral> The agent provided the necessary information about the denial reasons and clarified that the loan was not transferred, but I wish I had more details about the interest rate and total costs, even though the application was denied.
